title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Women’s Rights Programme in Kenya, implemented by ActionAid and nine women’s rights organisations, including two networks, works with marginalised women and girls , including survivors of violence in Taita Taveta and Garissa counties, to create a safer and more just society. The programme aims to reduce the risks of gender-based violence by increasing the knowledge, skills and capacity of marginalised women and girls to advocate for their rights, demand access to services and hold perpetrators to account. The programme also works with men, boys, local leaders and government officials to take action in support of women’s rights and demand accountability for violence and discrimination. Additionally it seeks to improve the incomes and livelihoods of marginalised women and survivors of violence and to strengthen their resilience to climate change through improved skills and leadership on climate change and through mobilising women, youth and communities to demand progressive climate policies that support women and girls. . Objective applies principally to gender equality with the understandng that women's leadership is crucial for achieving the SDGs
